entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 129:1-8 . The people of God, often delivered from enemies, are confident of His favor, by their overthrow in the future.

entries.heading: 2. prevailed
entries.text: 2. prevailed --literally, "been able," that is, to accomplish their purpose against me ( Ps 13:4 ).
3, 4. The ploughing is a figure of scourging, which most severe physical infliction aptly represents all kinds.

entries.heading: 4. the cords
entries.text: 4. the cords --that is, which fasten the plough to the ox; and cutting denotes God's arresting the persecution;
5, 6. The ill-rooted roof grass, which withers before it grows up and procures for those gathering it no harvest blessing ( Ru 2:4 ), sets forth the utter uselessness and the rejection of the wicked.
